Name: DGR 031 - RAMACH
Information:
**DGR 031 - RAMACH**

This DGR unit exists primarily as a transportation vehicle, designed for carting soldiers or DGR units to combat, or rescue those who need to be carried away. It has a combat mode and a mobile mode, which it transforms between to attack or defend itself. Its strength lies in its durability, but its offensive abilities are not impressive by the standards of other DGRs.

It has a combat mode and a mobile mode, which it transforms between to attack or defend itself. Its strength lies in its durability, but its offensive abilities are not impressive by the standards of other DGRs.

traits.name: Deployment Vehicle
traits.description: As long as it remains in mobile vehicle mode, the frame unit can hold other DGRs inside it and prepare them for deployment. DGRs require fewer points of capacity than equivalent creatures of their size: Huge takes 4, Large takes 2. Units taking fewer points this way are nestled into deployment bays, only partially intersecting with the usual space inside that creatures would occupy. A DGR nestled this way is incapacitated.

traits.name: Extra Reaction
traits.description: The frame unit has an extra reaction it spends before its usual one. This extra reaction is regained at the start of each turn.

actions.name: Slam (Combat Form Only)
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d10 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Twinning Wheel Fluctuator (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The frame unit creates a gravitational vortex around itself, forcing each creature within 60 feet of it to make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, they lose any fly, fly (hover), or 0-G acceleration speed they have for 1 minute, during which time they may repeat the saving throw at the end of each of their turns, ending the effect on a success. Creatures who plummet from the air because of this effect lose their flying speed only gradually, taking a maximum of 10d6 falling damage regardless of the height they fall from. Creatures who fail their save also take 22 (4d10) force damage, or half as much on a success.

actions.name: Mach Boost (Mobile Form Only)
actions.description: The frame unit doubles its movement speed until the end of its turn and takes the Dash action.

actions.name: Transformation: Aerial Shift
actions.description: The frame unit transforms into a mobile vehicle form and remains as such until it takes this action again to return to its tactical combat mode (its usual mode). In mobile vehicle mode, it cannot use its Slam action or make other weapon attacks (nor can its pilot take them through it), but its armor class increases by 5 and opportunity attacks made against it have disadvantage. While in mobile vehicle form, its movement speeds each increase by half their normal amount.

bonus_actions.name: Deploy Units
bonus_actions.description: The frame unit may eject any number of willing frame units contained inside of it into the area around it. These units are ejected to an unoccupied space that DGR 031 - RAMACH chooses, then each may use their reactions to move up to their movement speed. Creatures deployed this way have a +4 bonus to their armor class until the start of their next turn.

bonus_actions.name: Disengage
bonus_actions.description: The frame unit takes the Disengage action.

reactions.name: Return Fire (Mobile Form Only)
reactions.description: When the frame unit is hit by a weapon attack, it can fire off a series of thunderous bursts that strike its attacker. The triggering creature must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw, taking 11 (2d10) thunder damage on a failure. A creature who takes this damage has disadvantage on further attacks against the frame unit until the end of the turn.
